条目类型：单词语条（形容词 / 名词双栖）· 直接实据：reading/rebranding-art-museums.md:27（《Rebranding art
🔉 Pronunciation & Listening Cue
英式音标 (British IPA): /ɪmˈperətɪv/ (based on Oxford / Cambridge)美式音标 (American IPA
(中文说明：听到 -perə- 就往下想「这是要求」，听到 -pɪəri- 就想「帝国／傲慢」。)
📖 Core Definitions (Dictionary‑Based)
Source: Oxford Advanced Learner’s Dictionary / Cambridge Dictionary
[adjective, formal] Sense 1 – extremely important and urgent; that must be done（
(中文释义：是「事理上不做不行」，不是「制度规定必须」——后者用 compulsory / mandatory。)
-Pattern – It is imperative that + 主语 + (should) do / It is imperative to do
-Writing example – It is imperative that the museum should keep at least part of
（博物馆至少要把一部分藏品免费展出，这一点非做不可。）⚠ 自撰示例
[noun, countable] Sense 2 – something that must be done, especially because of a
(中文释义：本文的用法。前面常带 the，后面常接 of + 名词 或 to do。)
-原句（直接实据） – Even the most adroit organisation ... needs to be able to juggle num
（再老练的机构也得同时应付一堆互相打架的优先项：一头是推进学术，另一头是「必须让公众进得来」。）reading/rebranding-art-museums.m
-Writing example – For a publicly funded gallery, widening access is not a marke
（对靠公费养着的画廊来说，扩大开放面不是营销选择，而是道德上的硬要求。）⚠ 自撰示例
[noun, grammar] Sense 3 – the imperative ＝ the form of a verb used for giving or
(中文释义：语法术语里的那个「祈使句」，与上面两义无关，别在阅读里硬套。)
🎯 Best Situation & Register Gate（何时该用 / 何时别用）
✅ Best situation: ① 机构／政策的两难权衡——一边要学术、一边要开放（本文）；② 道德议题——a moral imperative；③ 正式书

> the need to advance scholarship, on the one hand, versus the imperative of acc
（中文说明：作者轮着用 need to + 动词 / imperative of + 名词 / necessity of + doing，全为避重复。自己写「两

(中文说明：听到 -perə- 就往下想「这是要求」，听到 -pɪəri- 就想「帝国／傲慢」。)
📖 Core Definitions (Dictionary‑Based)
Source: Oxford Advanced Learner’s Dictionary / Cambridge Dictionary
[adjective, formal] Sense 1 – extremely important and urgent; that must be done（
(中文释义：是「事理上不做不行」，不是「制度规定必须」——后者用 compulsory / mandatory。)
-Pattern – It is imperative that + 主语 + (should) do / It is imperative to do
-Writing example – It is imperative that the museum should keep at least part of
（博物馆至少要把一部分藏品免费展出，这一点非做不可。）⚠ 自撰示例
[noun, countable] Sense 2 – something that must be done, especially because of a
(中文释义：本文的用法。前面常带 the，后面常接 of + 名词 或 to do。)
-原句（直接实据） – Even the most adroit organisation ... needs to be able to juggle num
（再老练的机构也得同时应付一堆互相打架的优先项：一头是推进学术，另一头是「必须让公众进得来」。）reading/rebranding-art-museums.m
-Writing example – For a publicly funded gallery, widening access is not a marke
（对靠公费养着的画廊来说，扩大开放面不是营销选择，而是道德上的硬要求。）⚠ 自撰示例
[noun, grammar] Sense 3 – the imperative ＝ the form of a verb used for giving or
(中文释义：语法术语里的那个「祈使句」，与上面两义无关，别在阅读里硬套。)
